Great price on the server and discs, would strongly recommend the TechMikeNY team, hard to find high quality services, will be buying from them again.

Shipping was quick. Products arrived as they were described, and in better condition than I was expecting for a refurb server. I will buy from this seller again.

A+++ experience, highly recommended seller.
